statement.zh: 早期埃及农业与聚落须参照尼罗河洪水节律、洪泛平原土壤与低地水利约束来理解（Butzer 文化生态学框架）。
statement.en: Early Egyptian agriculture and settlement must be understood against Nile flood rhythms, floodplain soils, and lowland hydraulic constraints (Butzer’s cultural-ecology framing).

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-ancient-egypt.md only.
